# Humberto Alonso López

> AI Engineer and full-stack developer based in Aguascalientes, Mexico (UTC-6), open to remote work. Co-founder of Hemeron (hemeron.com). Builds LLM agents that run in production with the Claude API and the Claude Agent SDK, plus the TypeScript, Next.js, Go and PostgreSQL systems around them.

## Profile
- Role: AI Engineer, full-stack (TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, Go, PostgreSQL)
- AI: Claude API, Claude Agent SDK, Claude Code, OpenAI, Gemini, Vercel AI SDK, tool use, MCP, RAG, embeddings, evals, prompt caching, structured outputs
- Languages: Spanish (native), English (B2)
- Contact: alonso.humberto0401@gmail.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/halonso-l/
- GitHub: https://github.com/BetazoDev

## Work
- [Hemeron Prospector](https://halonso.digital/work/prospector/): AI sales pipeline. Multi-agent website builds on the Claude Agent SDK, a WhatsApp sales agent on the Claude API with model routing (about US$0.002 per Haiku reply), evals on 41 real chats, deterministic guardrails, 318 automated tests.
- [Agenda Hemeron](https://halonso.digital/work/agenda/): self-hosted scheduling with Google Calendar and Meet, round-robin teams, Postgres advisory locks, and an API used by AI agents.
- [Hemenú](https://halonso.digital/work/hemenu/): multi-tenant restaurant SaaS in Go with Postgres row-level security, an MCP server and a Claude vision menu importer.
- [Stenia](https://halonso.digital/work/stenia/): offline-capable training PWA that writes routines with Claude, Gemini or OpenAI through the Vercel AI SDK.
- [AB Abogados](https://halonso.digital/work/ab-abogados/): first paying client of the pipeline; 29-page law firm site with local SEO, JSON-LD and llms.txt.
